message.content:
The editorial illustration shows a white magazine cover with a red vertical border on the left and a red horizontal bar at the bottom. In the center, a large black silhouette of a man’s head in profile faces right. This silhouette has a rounded head, a prominent nose, and glasses. Inside this large silhouette, another smaller profile of a person is formed by negative white space on the left side, facing left.

The top of the cover features the word "TEMPO" in large, black, serif capital letters. Above it, in smaller grey capital letters, is the text "CARA AUSTRALIA MENYADAP SBY". Below the main title, the date "25 NOVEMBER-1 DESEMBER 2013" appears in small grey text. Inside the large black silhouette, the white text "SIASAT ABURIZAL" is centered in capital letters. 

In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode, the price "RP 33.000", a website URL "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and fine print including "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" and an ISSN number. In the bottom right corner, a black quote reads: "“Megawati Lawan Terberat Saya.”" The entire composition uses a high-contrast black, white, and red color palette.
